![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Apr 8, 2023

## [TERRIBLE Customer Service-all auto chat and slow. Item Not as Pictured](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64319a3f734f97e68f9a3c6c)
Item color is not even close to as pictured, but to make things a thousand times worse, customer service is all automated, very inefficient and beyond impersonal. Messages (via chat!! ugh!!) have at least a 24 hour delay between them (typically more) making that spacing impossible to accomplish anything. It has been nearly 3-weeks while I try to set up a return. Very frustrating after a furniture purchase worth nearly $2k.

March 21, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 10, 2023

Hi Valerie, I’m so sorry to hear about this experience with us! Thank you for your feedback regarding our Return process, we have shared this with our teams. We can see you've been corresponding with our Customer Experience team today and they’ve escalated these issues. We are available on Live Chat Monday-Friday 9am-5pm PST and we also offer scheduled phone call backs.
